notes: Group Battle now uses the clean Tournament-style battle layout so fighter HP bars and HP numbers stay visible
Removed old Multiplayer-only battle decorators so Group Battle now follows the Tournament battle structure consistently
Removed historical Multiplayer cosmetic wrappers that could move reserve portraits above the HP bar
Removed the old free PALIT action from Group Battle; switching is now earned after a correct answer
Correct answers from successful move 2 onward offer Attack, Heal, Defend, or Switch
Switch lets the team choose any other living teammate and consumes the turn
When an active player reaches 0 HP, the game no longer auto-selects the reserve
After a KO the team must choose the next living player with no replacement timer
Dead or 0-HP teammates cannot be selected
30 HP maximum damage, Teacher Forfeit, Group Rankings, and Group Tournament remain included
